saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Γρηγόριος Νεοκαισαρείας ο Θαυματουργός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The head line gives him «(; - 270)» and the body «γεννήθηκε περίπου το 210 με 215 μ.Χ.», and the folder carries no `dates` at all, so a `birth` and a `death` are proposed from those two statements — the birth as the page's own approximate range, basis `traditional`. The entry is plainly him: first named **Theodore**, of Greek idolatrous parents of high standing at Neocaesarea in Pontus — which the page says was also called Kabeiria, Diaspolis and Sebaste in antiquity and is Niksar today — who went with his brother to Berytus to study law and heard Origen at Caesarea on the way. **One thing for the writer:** the page says the brother was called «Γρηγόριο ή (σύμφωνα με μερικές αγιολογικές πηγές) Αθηνόδωρο» and sends the reader to 7 Νοεμβρίου for both — which is the same disagreement the 11-07 reader recorded on `athenodorus` and `gregory-brother-of-the-wonderworker`, and nothing further is proposed about it here. The Ἀπολυτίκιον and the first Κοντάκιον are taken and both name him; the «Έτερον Κοντάκιον» and the Μεγαλυνάριον are not. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (25 September 2026).

hymns.text: Întru rugăciuni priveghind, la lucrările minunilor răbdând, asemenea numire cu îndreptările ai câştigat. Ci, te roagă lui Hristos Dumnezeu, Părinte Grigorie, să lumineze sufletele noastre, ca să nu adormim în moarte cu păcate.

source.text: Doxologia — «Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Grigorie Taumaturgul, Episcopul Neocezareei», glas 8

english.text: Watchful in prayers and steadfast in the working of wonders, thou didst win a name to match thy deeds. Pray therefore to Christ God, father Gregory, to enlighten our souls, that we sleep not in death with our sins.

hymns.text: Ἐν προσευχαῖς γρηγορῶν, ταῖς τῶν θαυμάτων ἐργασίαις ἐγκαρτερῶν, ἐπωνυμίαν ἐκτήσω τὰ κατορθώματα, ἀλλὰ πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, Πάτερ Γρηγόριε, φωτίσαι τὰς ψυχὰς ἡμῶν, μὴ ποτὲ ὑπνώσωμεν, ἐν ἁμαρτίαις εἰς θάνατον.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’ — on the page of «Άγιος Γρηγόριος Νεοκαισαρείας ο Θαυματουργός», and it names him.

english.text: Watchful in prayers, persevering in the working of wonders, you won your name from your own achievements; but intercede with Christ our God, Father Gregory, to enlighten our souls, that we may never fall asleep in sins unto death.

hymns.text: Θαυμάτων πολλῶν, δεξάμενος ἐνέργειαν, σημείοις φρικτοῖς, τοὺς δαίμονας ἐπτόησας, καὶ τὰς νόσους ἤλασας τῶν ἀνθρώπων, πάνσοφε Γρηγόριε· διὸ καλῇ θαυματουργός, τὴν κλῆσιν ἐξ ἔργων κομισάμενος.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’. Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν — the first of two kontakia on his page, and it names him.

english.text: Having received the working of many wonders, you terrified the demons with fearful signs and drove out the sicknesses of men, all-wise Gregory; and so you are called wonderworker, having taken your title from your deeds.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Γρηγόριος γεννήθηκε περίπου το 210 με 215 μ.Χ.» The page's own range is kept as the interval.

death.note: saint.gr's head line: «Αγιος Γρηγοριος Νεοκαισαρειας ο Θαυματουργος (; - 270)». The body of the page gives no year for his death.
